$comment: One authority per concern, plus the architecture disposition that justifies that owner.
Assigned concerns must be USE EXISTING, PLUGIN, or TEMP WORKAROUND.
A TEMP WORKAROUND must name the condition that deletes it; correctness and test volume do not make it permanent.
Unassigned concerns stay explicit so the next package cannot silently become an overlapping authority.

concerns.note: Prime owns the daemon supervisor, resident/client-owned workers, session leases, command journals, schedules, RLM children, sessions and ACP. Command Governor does not recreate them.
Prime's session JSONL is the session/transcript authority. Command Governor ships no competing transcript format.
Command-Governor-specific pin enforcement refuses a daemon whose hello disagrees with pins.json before commands are sent.
Command Governor's positive environment allowlist is a product security policy applied at the Prime boundary.

concerns.removalCondition: Delete or reduce to a package-level preflight once the intended Prime package path proves every Governor-created session has the required explicit persistent canonical path without this standalone module.
concerns.note: D8 compatibility policy retained only until the package-shaped product proves the same invariant at the higher-level Prime API.

concerns.removalCondition: Delete when package-path D1 recovery proves Prime's high-level session identity/reconnect surfaces reject stale incarnations and recover the same logical session without an external Governor registry.
concerns.note: D1 external-daemon adaptation only. It is not a permanent second session authority.

concerns.removalCondition: Delete the custom reopen loop when the actual package/plugin path recovers or safely reopens the same logical Prime session without duplicate roots under the D1 black-box reproducer.
concerns.note: D1 compatibility behavior, retained pending the package-path reproducer required by ADR 0010.

concerns.removalCondition: Delete when the intended package/plugin product path no longer consumes raw finalized daemon mutation failures in a way that can mint/re-drive a duplicate effect, or Prime upstream exposes trustworthy uncertain-effect semantics directly.
concerns.note: D2 fail-closed classifier for the known Prime worker-loss journal defect; not a general Governor mutation framework.

concerns.removalCondition: Delete when the package-path D2 worker-loss reproducer proves no duplicate external effect without an external Governor mutation/replacement authority; otherwise retain only the minimum shim still required by that reproducer.
concerns.note: D2 compatibility ledger. Test depth does not grant permanent ownership.
Product-specific role defaults. Generic delegation/runtime behavior must still come from Prime or a selected package.
Focused Command Governor distribution/package conformance. Tests protect product invariants or named temporary workarounds, not historical implementation topology.

concerns.plannedOwner: Prime/package capability if sufficient; otherwise the smallest Command Governor policy extension
concerns.note: Role files are definitions, not an excuse to build another child runtime. Prove the package gap before assigning an owner.

concerns.plannedOwner: an existing Pi-native exact-thread transport such as the selected pi-oracle/pi-gpt path, wrapped only if Command-Governor-specific correlation policy is missing
concerns.note: Test existing transport candidates before bespoke browser/CDP machinery.

concerns.plannedOwner: selected task/review/transport package state or the smallest proven Command Governor extension
concerns.note: Do not assume a new sidecar store is required. Prove stale-revision/durable-disposition gaps on the assembled package path first.

concerns.plannedOwner: exactly one selected Prime/Pi memory or compaction owner
concerns.note: Only one owner; exact control facts remain deterministic rather than model-memory authority.

concerns.plannedOwner: a selected existing package if downstream-action evaluation demonstrates value
concerns.note: Optional and advisory. Do not build a Governor memory engine.

concerns.plannedOwner: Prime/package hook policy if sufficient; otherwise one small Command Governor policy extension
concerns.note: One arbiter only. Existing hook/tool-gating capabilities are evaluated before custom code.

concerns.plannedOwner: Prime's stable ACP v1 server when ACP is actually part of a shipped path
concerns.note: ACP is interoperability, not internal durability authority. Do not add permanent ACP tests before adoption.

concerns.plannedOwner: an existing isolation mechanism selected only for untrusted workloads that require it
concerns.note: Optional hardening for intentionally untrusted workloads; not a prerequisite for the trusted-local core product.
